name: unlock-failed-raw
description: A failed unlock under `format: "raw"`, recorded live 2026-10-04 (Web Unlocker, `country: "aq"` — a valid code with no peers). Bright Data accepted the request, so the outer status is 200 with an empty body; the verdict rides ONLY in headers: `x-brd-error-code: no_peers` and `x-brd-status-code: 502`. The provider lifecycle reads them and settles OURS 502 / THEIRS 200 — a provider error, zero usage — lifting the code into the `format: "json"` envelope shape so the caller sees why (design D4).
